title: Create and save a Bengali MCQ question and verify confirmation + live preview update
description: Verifies a teacher can create a Bengali MCQ with options, correct answer, marks, difficulty, save it successfully, and see the live preview reflect the new question.

steps.description: Click on "Questions" in the main navigation
Select a class from the Class dropdown
Select a subject from the Subject dropdown
Type "বাংলাদেশের রাজধানী কোনটি?" into the Question Text field
Click to mark "ঢাকা" as the correct option
Select a value from the Marks dropdown (or type a numeric mark if an input is provided)
Select a value from the Difficulty dropdown
Verify the live preview area is visible
Verify text "বাংলাদেশের রাজধানী কোনটি?" is visible

title: Validation: prevent saving when question text is empty
description: Verifies the editor shows a validation error when attempting to save without entering question text.

steps.description: Click on "Questions" in the main navigation
Select a class from the Class dropdown
Select a subject from the Subject dropdown
Select a question type (MCQ/Short/Broad) from the question type control
Verify text "Question text required" is visible

title: Create a Bengali Short question and save successfully
description: Verifies a teacher can create a Bengali short question, set marks and difficulty, save, and see the saved confirmation and preview content.

steps.description: Click on "Questions" in the main navigation
Select a class from the Class dropdown
Select a subject from the Subject dropdown
Type "বায়ুমণ্ডলের প্রধান গ্যাস কোনটি?" into the Question Text field
Select a value from the Marks dropdown (or type a numeric mark if an input is provided)
Select a value from the Difficulty dropdown
Verify text "বায়ুমণ্ডলের প্রধান গ্যাস কোনটি?" is visible

title: Create a Bengali Broad question and save successfully
description: Verifies a teacher can create a broad question with Bengali text, set marks and difficulty, and save successfully.

steps.description: Click on "Questions" in the main navigation
Select a class from the Class dropdown
Select a subject from the Subject dropdown
Type "মুক্তিযুদ্ধের পটভূমি ও গুরুত্ব আলোচনা কর।" into the Question Text field
Select a value from the Marks dropdown (or type a numeric mark if an input is provided)
Select a value from the Difficulty dropdown
Verify text "মুক্তিযুদ্ধের পটভূমি ও গুরুত্ব আলোচনা কর।" is visible

title: MCQ edge case: attempt to save without selecting a correct option
description: Verifies the editor prevents saving an MCQ if no correct option is selected, showing a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on "Questions" in the main navigation
Select a class from the Class dropdown
Select a subject from the Subject dropdown
Type "বাংলা ভাষা দিবস কোন তারিখে পালিত হয়?" into the Question Text field
Type "২১ ফেব্রুয়ারি" into Option A field
Type "২৬ মার্চ" into Option B field
Type "১৬ ডিসেম্বর" into Option C field
Type "১ জানুয়ারি" into Option D field
Verify text "Select correct option" is visible

title: Add a new question section, enter a second Bengali question, and save draft
description: Verifies adding an additional question section, filling the second question text, saving as draft, and seeing a draft saved notification.

steps.description: Click on "Questions" in the main navigation
Type "প্রাণীর কোষের প্রধান অংশগুলো কী কী?" into the first Question Text field
Click the "Add New Question Section" button
Type "উদ্ভিদ কোষ ও প্রাণী কোষের দুটি পার্থক্য লেখ।" into the second Question Text field

title: Draft validation: prevent saving draft when second section is empty
description: Verifies the editor shows a visible validation error when attempting to save a draft with an added section left empty.

steps.description: Click on "Questions" in the main navigation
Type "পানির তিনটি অবস্থা কী?" into the first Question Text field
Click the "Add New Question Section" button
Verify text "Question text required" is visible

title: Bengali input handling: verify Bengali characters persist in editor and preview after save
description: Verifies the editor accepts Bengali punctuation and numerals and that the same text is visible in the live preview after saving.

steps.description: Click on "Questions" in the main navigation
Type "১৯৭১ সালে বিজয় দিবস কত তারিখে? (উত্তর: ১৬ ডিসেম্বর)" into the Question Text field
Verify text "১৯৭১ সালে বিজয় দিবস কত তারিখে?" is visible
